Format.description: The file's format name; first key of the file.

Version.description: The format version this build writes; older versions are migrated when read.

Scene.description: The scene the replay starts in.

Parameters.description: The Scene.Load parameters the scene starts with (free-form).

FixedHz.description: The fixed simulation rate the replay was recorded at.

EngineVersion.description: The replay format's engine version, which every recorder writes as "0.1.0" (ReplayEngineVersionString) whatever the build, so neither a version bump nor a commit rewrites a replay (informational).

Config.description: The run mode that recorded the replay (Editor, Release or Dist), never the build configuration; informational.

Fingerprint.description: The start fingerprint: what the recorded session held at tick 0, so a playback whose state hash differs names what changed since the recording (a component, an entity, a script, a material, another referenced asset). Null for a replay upgraded from version 1 or 2, which names no change until it is recorded again.

Entities.description: Every entity of the scene at tick 0, sorted by id.

items.description: One entity of the scene at tick 0.

Id.description: The entity's id; the entities are sorted by id.

Path.description: The entity's path at tick 0 (readable, never compared).

Hash.description: XXH64 (seed 0) of the entity's own members (its id, name, parent, active flag and tags) as the scene's minified canonical serialization writes them: 16 lowercase hex digits.

Components.description: Each serialized component by name, in the scene file's order (the registered ones in registry order, then native and unknown ones), with the hash of its value.

additionalProperties.description: XXH64 (seed 0) of the component's value as the scene's minified canonical serialization writes it.

Assets.description: Every asset an asset reference of those components names (a script and its asset fields, a mesh, a material, ...), once, sorted by handle; procedural built-ins and assets that only other assets reference are not listed.

Handle.description: The asset's handle; the assets are sorted by handle.

Path.description: The asset's reference path when it was recorded (readable, never compared).

Hash.description: XXH64 (seed 0) of the asset's cooked artifact, the same in the editor's cache and in an exported pak: 16 lowercase hex digits.

Events.description: The applied input events, ordered by tick.

Tick.description: The tick the event applies at (step 1 of the tick), before FinalTick; events are ordered by tick.

State.description: Action, Key, MouseButton, GamepadButton: the button state.

Value.description: Action (axis) and GamepadAxis: the value; triggers range from 0 to 1.

Button.description: MouseButton and GamepadButton: the button's name.

Gamepad.description: GamepadButton and GamepadAxis: the gamepad index.

Position.description: MouseMove (and optionally MouseButton): the cursor position in view pixels.

Tick.description: The tick the expression is evaluated at, at or before FinalTick.

Luau.description: A Luau chunk that returns true when the expectation holds.

Checkpoints.description: The state hashes the recording observed along its run, one every 60 ticks before FinalTick, each at a completed-tick boundary (none at a tick inside a frame where a test suite's scripted clock ran several steps; a reader accepts any increasing ticks). Verification with strictHash compares each as playback reaches its tick and stops at the first that differs.

Tick.description: The completed-tick boundary of the checkpoint: after tick 0, before FinalTick, increasing strictly.

StateHash.description: The state hash the recording observed at Tick: 16 lowercase hex digits.

FinalTick.description: The last tick of the replay.

FinalStateHash.description: The state hash at FinalTick: 16 lowercase hex digits. It covers the simulated world (every entity with its serialized components, the tick, the session's Random state, the id draws and every body's physics state), never script tables, audio or input.
